App details

Age & Date Toolkit

Find exact ages, compare dates and count down to birthdays and anniversaries.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Calculate exact age, date differences and time until the next birthday or anniversary; add or subtract calendar periods from dates. Designed for offline use.

Main features

  • Age in years, months and days.
  • Add or subtract years, months, weeks and days.
  • Save named dates and copy results.
  • Calculations work offline.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Calendar calculations and saved dates

Exact age

Enter a birth date and reference date, normally today. The result gives completed years, remaining months and days, plus total elapsed days. It handles leap years; a February 29 birthday falls on February 28 in a non-leap year.

Date difference and countdown

Choose two dates to see years, months and days or total days, with reversed order indicated. September 1 to 2 is one day. The until/since shortcut compares a chosen date with today and says days remaining, days elapsed or today. An optional weeks-and-remaining-days view helps compare longer intervals.

Add or subtract a calendar period

Choose a starting date and add or subtract years, months, weeks and days. The result is a calendar date, with years then months then weeks then days applied. If the target day does not exist, use month-end: January 31 plus one month becomes February 28 or 29.

Next birthday or anniversary

Enter the original date and a reference date. See the next occurrence, weekday, days remaining and anniversary number where applicable. An event on the reference day is shown as today. The remaining time is also shown as months and days.

Date information

Select a valid date to see its weekday, numbered day of the year, days left after it in that year and ISO week number. Useful for checking a date without doing a separate calculation.

Saved dates and copying

Save a date with a non-empty name, edit or delete it, and reuse it in relevant calculations. Copy results to notes or messages. Saved dates remain on your device; clearing a current calculation is separate from deleting saved dates.

A backwards clock surprise

Tap the About logo seven times. The hidden About activity shows an analogue clock with reversed numbering and hands moving backwards from the current local time. Close it to return; it works offline and changes no dates or settings.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
